svg.title: The Purdue Model: IT and OT segmentation
svg.desc: Six functional levels from enterprise IT to physical processes, with an industrial DMZ at Level 3.5. Includes segmentation, blast radius reduction and Zero Trust context.
svg.text: IT / OT segmentation | Six functional levels + an industrial DMZ security boundary
Cybersecurity adaptation of the Purdue Enterprise Reference Architecture (PERA).

Conceptual model, not a deployment topology. Systems may span levels; process safety requires its own engineered protections.

a.text: Sources: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to OT Security
